column1: # ComputerBase — AMD Radeon RX 9070 (XT) im Test, Gaming-Benchmarks Parts 1-3
# A SAMPLE of four of the review's 23 games, not the review. The article
# publishes roughly 1,230 figures; taking all of them would be a substantial
# part of ComputerBase's compilation, which is what the corpus's per-source
# concentration cap exists to prevent. Four games preserve the whole GPU ladder
# — the thing the fit actually needs — at about a sixth of the article.
# Figures read from the article's own chart markup, where ComputerBase publishes
# each bar's exact value in a data-value attribute — so these are transcribed,
# not estimated or read off an image. Average and P1 (their 1% percentile).
# NOT imported from this review, on purpose:
#   - the 3.440 x 1.440 charts: 21:9 ultrawide is 34% more pixels than 16:9 at
#     the same height, and RESOLUTIONS has no slot for it. Filing it under
#     1440p would assert a pixel count nobody measured.
#   - Lego: Horizon Adventures: run at "70 % TSR", which is not one of the
#     named UPSCALING modes. Calling it Quality (66.7%) would misstate it.
#   - one cell (KCD2 / 1440p / Arc B580) has an average but no P1 in the
#     source, so it lands with no low rather than an invented one.
